$comment: DETERMINISTIC evaluation suite of the copilot (scripts/evals.py deterministic, docs/evaluaciones.md). Grouped like the harness: GUIDES (what steers the agent BEFORE it decides), RULES (the brakes, `pre_tool_call`) and SIGNALS (the sensors AFTER). Cases live in `caseFiles`, one file per group, and each case says its content language (`lang`: en · es · neutral): the same check in English and in Spanish shows whether a pattern only knows one language. Keys and enumerated values are always English. Each case holds what a GOOD harness should do, not what it does today; none comes from the config `example`s (the self-test already covers those). `files` and `integrations` build the test copilot. `{code}` in a guide or a signal is a code file of the installed profile (`observability.probe.filePath`). Strings compared against the harness output, which is Spanish (`contains`, `reasonCriteria.nextStepWords`), stay in Spanish on purpose.
